name: hami-hamrah-store
description: Hami Hamrah — Persian B2C + B2B (mobile phone & accessories) e-commerce platform: Next.js App Router (REST API + storefront) with Prisma/PostgreSQL

scripts._comment_db_reset: db:reset is intentionally disabled: prisma/migrations only has a Session-only migration (schema was always managed via `db push`, no baseline migration exists), so `migrate reset` would drop the whole DB and replay just the sessions table. Use db:fresh instead. See db:reset:UNSAFE_missing_baseline if you truly need the old behavior after generating a full baseline migration.
scripts.db:reset: echo 'db:reset is disabled: no migration baseline exists yet (see prisma/migrations) — migrate reset would drop the whole DB and only recreate the sessions table. Use "npm run db:fresh" instead (prisma db push --force-reset).' && exit 1
scripts.db:reset:UNSAFE_missing_baseline: prisma migrate reset --force --skip-seed && npm run db:generate && npm run db:seed
scripts.db:fresh: prisma db push --force-reset --accept-data-loss && npm run db:generate && npm run db:seed
